title: FantacalcioIdentityCandidate
description: Design-only identity candidate for a player or team (Batch 0E). Cross-season canonical ids are NOT assumed stable from the Fantacalcio 'Cod.' (see RISK_REGISTER R1). canonical_*_id stays null until identity is in data_promoted; ambiguous/under-threshold candidates MUST go to manual review, never auto-promoted. NO real data here: fixtures are synthetic.

canonical_player_id.description: Null until promoted (data_promoted). Set only for entity_kind=player after manual/auto resolution.

canonical_team_id.description: Null until promoted. Set only for entity_kind=team after resolution.

source_name.description: Raw name as it appears in the source.

normalized_name.description: Deterministic normalized form: lowercase, accents->ascii, trimmed, spaces collapsed.

team_context.description: Team the player was observed with (null for entity_kind=team or when unknown).

external_ids.description: Per-source external ids, e.g. {source_id: fantacalcio_xlsx, external_id: '<Cod.>'}. NOT stable cross-season.

ambiguity_kind.description: Set when identity_status is ambiguous/requires_manual_review; null otherwise.

acquisition_ref.description: Reference to the acquisition that surfaced this name (e.g. acquisition_id). No secrets.

canonical_promoted.description: Always false in Batch 0E: identities are not promoted here.
